items.title: Sadiki nets late winner as Sunderland survive huge scare at Torreense
items.description: Sunderland survived a huge scare as they came from behind to clinch back-to-back Europa League victories with a 2-1 win over Torreense following Noah Sadiki’s 93rd-minute winner.

items.title: Sage suffers defeat to former side as Palace lose in Lyon
items.description: Pierre Sage lost to his former side as Crystal Palace fell to a 3-2 defeat to Lyon in the Europa League

items.title: Sutton's predictions v boxer & Ipswich fan Fabio Wardley
items.description: BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on boxer and Ipswich fan Fabio Wardley, plus the BBC readers and AI with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures.

items.title: Man Utd latest: Martinez met hierarchy before apology - should he start vs Leeds?
Martinez apologises for outburst after Wilcox talks
items.description: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez has issued an apology for his outburst after Tuesday's Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid.

items.title: Martinez apologises for outburst and fined by Man Utd
items.description: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez issues an apology following his controversial remarks criticising the club's hierarchy.

items.title: Long-term success won't be linear, says Spurs Women boss Ho
items.description: Very few successes ever come easy. Whether it's title wins or top three finishes, every WSL season is becoming harder to predict - and plenty of clubs, including Tottenham, have their eyes on the prizes.

items.title: Kane agrees new deal in principle with Bayern Munich
items.description: Harry Kane has agreed a new deal in principle with Bayern Munich until the summer of 2029.

items.title: Moore's Germany move inspired by Sancho and Bellingham
items.description: Tottenham loanee Mikey Moore says the success of Jadon Sancho and Jude Bellingham in the Bundesliga influenced his decision to join Cologne.

items.title: Infantino sorry for World Cup plan and set to ditch Peace Prize
items.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has apologised for his World Cup sell-off plan at a three-hour FIFA Council meeting in Zurich on Thursday - and the Peace Prize he awarded to US President Donald Trump looks set to be ditched.

items.title: Eom has strength to move on after alleged racist abuse, says Swansea boss
items.description: Vitor Matos says Eom Jisung has the strength to move on from the alleged racial abuse which marred Swansea City's win at Millwall.

items.title: Red card, suspension and a conspiracy - what's up with Vini Jr?
items.description: Vinicius Jr speaks to the press after being handed a four-match ban following his red card against Villarreal.
